'''Nogometni klub Brda Dobrovo''' ({{langx|en|Brda Dobrovo Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Brda''' or simply '''Brda''', is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Dobrovo]] that competes in the [[Slovenian Regional Leagues|Littoral League]], the fourth highest league in Slovenia. The club was founded in 1973.<ref name = "Klubi"/>"}}
